changelog: - **`MatchScoreBreakdown` — the explainability surface for match scores** (#1785). A pure presentational component (`src/components/matching/MatchScoreBreakdown.tsx`) rendering the `{ score, breakdown, blockedBy }` shape `scoreMatch()` will return (#1781), typed in the new client-safe `src/lib/matching/types.ts`. Compact mode is a colour-tiered percentage pill plus the top-contributing dimension for a list row; full mode is a score ring over one row per rule — localised dimension name, pass/fail marker, weight, contribution in points and the evidence strings as badges. Hard-rule failures render first in their own red panel with each blocking rule named, so a blocked pair never reads as a low score. The "rule-satisfaction percentage, not a prediction of success" footer is unconditional and there is deliberately no number-only variant: this is the human-readable half of a high-risk automated decision under the EU AI Act, and the deterministic score is never labelled "AI". New `matchScore` dictionary block in EN/TR/DE, plus a `.match-score`-scoped dark-mode compound override in `globals.css` for the accent text that sits on the white card rather than in a tinted box. No screen renders it yet — wiring into the mentor suggestion list follows behind #1781.

en: Match scores can now be explained rule by rule: a score ring, one row per criterion showing what matched and what did not, and a clearly separate red panel when a pairing is blocked outright by a hard rule rather than merely scoring low.
tr: Eşleşme skorları artık kural kural açıklanabiliyor: bir skor halkası, her ölçüt için neyin tuttuğunu neyin tutmadığını gösteren birer satır ve bir eşleşme kesin bir kuralla engellendiğinde düşük skordan açıkça ayrılan kırmızı bir bölüm.
de: Match-Scores lassen sich jetzt Regel für Regel erklären: ein Score-Ring, pro Kriterium eine Zeile mit Erfüllt/Nicht erfüllt und ein deutlich abgesetzter roter Bereich, wenn eine Paarung durch eine harte Regel gesperrt ist statt nur schwach zu punkten.
